Macros (Per Bowl - Makes 4) Calories — 500 Protein — 58g Carbs — 52g Fat — 5g Ingredients 🥣 2 lb or 32oz chicken breast, Raw 4 medium bell peppers (color doesn’t matter) 2 packets of  Fajita seasoning 5-second spray or ~5g avocado oil spray 2 1/2 cups or 600g cooked jasmine rice High Protein Sauce 💪 1/2 cup or 100g nonfat plain Greek yogurt 2 tbsp or 25g sriracha 1/2 lime, juiced Garlic powder How to make: 🧑‍🍳 1️⃣ Start by getting your rice cooking in a rice cooker or pot. 2️⃣ Dice your chicken and bell peppers, then add everything to a bowl with your fajita seasoning and mix until evenly coated. 3️⃣ Lightly spray your air fryer basket with avocado oil spray, add your chicken and peppers, and air fry at 400°F (200C) for about 20 minutes, tossing halfway through, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (75°C). 4️⃣ While that cooks, make your high-protein sauce by mixing together the Greek yogurt, sriracha, lime juice and garlic powder. 5️⃣ Once everything is cooked, evenly divide your rice, chicken and peppers between 4 meal prep containers and finish each one with your high-protein sauce. Viral Pepperoni Pizza Caesar Wrap Recipe 🍕 made this wrap for dinner and my family enjoy it! It’s like having a pizza and a Caesar salad together but without the carbs☺️ Makes 2 wraps Ingredients For the Cheese Wraps * 1½ cups freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella cheese * 14–16 pepperoni slices * sprinkle with oregano and red pepper flakes For the Caesar Salad * 1 head romaine lettuce * ¼ cup crushed croutons * Extra parmesan cheese, for topping For the Caesar Dressing * ¼ cup Best Foods mayonnaise * ¼ cup 0% Greek yogurt * Juice from ½ lemon * 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce * 1½ tsp Dijon mustard * 1 large garlic clove, grated * ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese * ¼–½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ¾ cup freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella into a thin tortilla-sized circle. Top each with 7–8 pepperoni slices and sprinkle with the oregano and red pepper flakes. 3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy around the edges and golden brown. 4. Slice the romaine lettuce lengthwise, chop into thin strips, rinse under cold water, and dry very well using a salad spinner. 5. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, garlic, parmesan, and black pepper. 6. Toss the romaine with most of the dressing, crushed croutons, and parmesan cheese. 7. Let the wraps cool slightly, then fill with the Caesar salad. Top with extra parmesan, croutons, and dressing if desired. #dinnerideas #easydinners #caesarsalad #pizza #wrap

Nashville Hot Chicken x Garlic Bread🔥 Crispy double-dredged Nashville hot chicken, with melty mozzarella, pickles, and homemade ranch, all packed onto garlic bread 😮‍💨 this thing will disappear FAST Garlic butter: 4 tbsp butter, softened 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 tbsp chopped parsley Chicken: 3 chicken thighs 3/4 cup flour 1/4 cup cornstarch 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp cayenne 1/2 tsp salt 2 eggs, beaten 4 cups oil, for frying Nashville hot sauce: 1/2 cup hot oil, reserved from frying the chicken 2 tbsp cayenne pepper 1 tbsp brown sugar 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp chili powder 1/2 tsp salt Ranch: 1/2 cup mayo 1/2 cup sour cream 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice 1 tsp dried dill 1 tsp dried parsley 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp onion powder 1/2 tsp salt 1/4 tsp black pepper To build: 1/2 loaf French or Italian bread 1 cup shredded mozzarella Sliced sweet pickles Steps 1.  Whisk flour, cornstarch, paprika, garlic powder, cayenne, and salt in a bowl. Beat eggs separately. 2.  Whisk mayo, sour cream, lemon juice, dill, parsley, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper for the ranch. 3.  Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot or skillet. Dredge chicken in the flour mix, then egg wash, then flour mix again for a double coating. 4.  Fry until golden and 165°F internal, about 4-5 min. Drain on a rack. Save 1/2 cup oil for the Hot Oil 5.  Whisk the reserved hot oil with cayenne, brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, chili powder, and salt. Toss the fried chicken in the sauce. 6.  Preheat oven to 400°F. Spread garlic butter evenly on the split loaf. 7.  Top with mozzarella. Bake 5-6 min until fully melted. 8.  Remove and layer the sauced chicken on top, then add more cheese. 9.  Broil 3-4 min until the second layer melts. Remove.  10.  Top with pickles, then drizzle ranch over the top. 11.  Slice and serve Enjoy! #easyrecipesathome #garlicbread #nashvillehotchicken #cooking #viralrecipes

Creamy Peri Peri Chicken Pasta🍗🧀🍝 Another game changing sheet pan meal prep. This pasta tastes unreal, low effort, easy to make for the week!🤌🏽🔥 Macros Per Serving (8 Total) 592 Calories | 55g Protein | 54g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 8 Servings) Peri Peri Chicken - 1500g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, fat trimmed - 3 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 4 Tsp Oregano - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 4 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Parsley - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Coriander/Cilantro - 1 Lemon Juiced - 8 Tsp Olive Oil - 100g Nando’s Peri Peri Medium Sauce (used to brush over the chicken before cooking) - Avocado Cooking Spray (4 Tsp worth) Creamy Peri Peri Pasta - 200-250g White & Red Onion, chopped - 200-250g Red & Green Bell Pepper, chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Garlic Powder - 2 Tsp Oregano - 2 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 120-150g Tomato Paste - 180g Light Cream Cheese - 400ml Light Evaporated Milk - 150g Peri Peri Medium Sauce - 480g Uncooked Protein Rigatoni Pasta / ~800-900g Cooked Pasta - Fresh Chopped Parsley 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from the chicken thighs. Add seasoning, fresh parsley and coriander, lemon juice, and olive oil. Mix until evenly coated and let marinate if time allows. 2. Line a sheet pan and spread the marinated chicken in a single layer. Brush with peri peri sauce and lightly spray with avocado oil. Bake in a preheated oven at 200C / 400F for 22-25 minutes until golden and juicy. While it cooks, boil the pasta, drain, and set aside. 3. Remove the chicken and keep all the pan juices. Add chopped onion and bell pepper, toss in the juices, spread flat, and roast at 180C / 370F for 15 minutes until soft and lightly charred. 4. While pan is hot, add extra seasoning, tomato paste, cream cheese, milk, peri peri sauce. Mix gently until melted creamy - the residual heat will help emulsify sauce. If needed, return to oven for 5 minutes. 5. Stir in cooked pasta and parsley until coated. Slice peri peri chicken, serve over pasta, and ENJOY! . . . #periperichicken #healthyrecipes #pasta #mealprep #sheetpandinner

Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice This Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice is a cozy, comforting dinner featuring juicy golden chicken served over fluffy rice with a rich, buttery Parmesan garlic sauce. It's simple enough for busy weeknights but delicious enough to feel like a special homemade meal. Ingredients • 1 1/2 pounds chicken tenderloins • 3 cups cooked white rice • 2 tablespoons olive oil • 3 tablespoons butter • 4 cloves garlic, minced • 1 cup chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese • 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning • 1/2 teaspoon paprika • 1/2 teaspoon onion powder • Salt and black pepper, to taste • 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley Instructions Season the chicken with paprika, Italian seasoning, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes per side until golden brown and fully cooked. Transfer to a plate. Reduce the heat to medium and melt the butter in the same skillet. Add the garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in the chicken broth and stir, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Add the heavy cream and let the sauce simmer gently for 2 to 3 minutes. Whisk in the Parmesan cheese until the sauce is smooth and creamy. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. Simmer for another 2 minutes. Serve the chicken over warm cooked rice and drizzle generously with the creamy garlic butter sauce. Finish with fresh parsley and extra Parmesan if desired. Prep Time: 10 minutes | Cook Time: 25 minutes | Total Time: 35 minutes Servings: 6 | Calories: About 620 per serving #dinner #easyrecipes #chicken #comfortfood #rice

What’s for dinner tonight? A little taste of sunshine in a pot! 🍋 This Greek lemon chicken and potatoes is an easy weeknight dinner where the oven does all the hard work. Served with a fresh Greek salad, it’s a meal I come back to time and time again. Definitely a family favorite! Prep time: 20 minutes  Bake time: 2 hours  Yields: 7-8 servings  Ingredients: 4 to 5 golden potatoes, peeled and quartered (3 lbs) 7 pieces of chicken (bone-in thighs and drumsticks work beautifully, but use your favorite!) (2 lbs. 10 oz )  You can also use boneless pieces as well, reduce bake time by 30 minutes.  For the sauce: Juice of 2 large lemons about 1/2 cup  1/4 cup good-quality olive oil 1 tbsp Dijon mustard 6 garlic cloves, minced 2 to 3 tsp salt A few sprigs of fresh oregano or 1 tbsp. Dried oregano  1/4 cup water  Dairy free Greek salad:  6 Persian cucumbers  3 beefsteak tomatoes  1 red pepper  1/2 red onion  1 cup pitted Kalamata olives  1 bunch flat head parsley  Dressing:  1/3 cup olive oil  1/4 cup fresh lemon juice  2 tbsp. Red wine vinegar  2 minced garlic cloves  1 tbsp. dried oregano  2 tsp. salt  1 tsp. black pepper  Instructions: Prep the chicken and potatoes:  Peel and rinse your golden potatoes, then cut them into large wedges. Wash and pat dry your chicken pieces. Layer in your pot: Arrange the chicken pieces in a large oven-safe pot or braiser (I use a 14-inch cast iron). Lay the potato wedges on top.  Tip: If your pot has plastic handles, wrap them in foil and you're good to go in the oven. No oven-safe lid? Cover with parchment and foil. Make the sauce: In a jar, combine the olive oil, fresh lemon juice, Dijon mustard, minced garlic, salt, and oregano. Give it a good shake until everything is well mixed and emulsified. Assemble: Pour the sauce evenly over the chicken and potatoes. Add 1/4 cup water to the jar, mix again and pour over.  Bake: Cover and bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 1 hour and 30 minutes. Finish uncovered: After 1.5 hours, remove the lid, baste the chicken and potatoes with those delicious juices, and return to the oven uncovered for 30 minutes, until everything is golden and caramelized. While the chicken is baking, prepare the salad. Combine everything in a bowl.  Prepare the dressing in the sane jar as the sauce for the chicken. Mix well and dress salad.  Toss and enjoy ❤️ Every bite is bursting with flavor — fresh, zesty, and comforting. Let the oven do the work, and enjoy a little taste of Greece right at home. #onepanmeal #sivanskitchen #easyrecipe #greekchicken #chickenandpotatoes

Ingredients: •1 Pound Flank Steak, sliced into thin strips •1 Red Bell Pepper, chopped •1 Green Bell Pepper, chopped •1 Medium Yellow Onion, chopped •Pinch of Salt, for vegetables •2 Tablespoons Avocado Oil, or neutral oil of choice, to cook steak & vegetables Steak Marinade: • 2 Tablespoons Low-Sodium Soy Sauce • 4 Cloves Garlic, minced • 1 Tablespoon Avocado Oil, or neutral cooking oil of choice • 2 Teaspoons reduced-sodium Rice Vinegar •1½ Teaspoons Cornstarch •½ Teaspoon Black Pepper •½ Teaspoon Granulated White sugar, or brown sugar •½ Teaspoon Baking Soda Sauce: •½ Cup Low-Sodium Soy Sauce •2 Tablespoons Beef Stock, or unsalted beef stock •2 Tablespoons reduced-sodium Rice Vinegar •1½ Tablespoon Granulated White Sugar, or brown sugar •2 Teaspoons Cornstarch •¼ Teaspoon Black Pepper •(optional) 2 Tablespoons of water, to dilute if too salty for your taste Instructions: 1. Pat steak dry. Thinly slice flank steak against the grain into about ¼-inch strips. Add steak into a medium-sized bowl. 2. For the steak marinade, toss the steak in soy sauce, minced garlic, oil, rice vinegar, cornstarch, black pepper, sugar, and baking soda. Mix well and fully coat the steak in the marinade. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes, up to 1 hour. 3. To make the sauce, in a separate medium-sized bowl add in soy sauce, beef stock, rice vinegar, sugar, cornstarch, and black pepper. Mix and whisk together ingredients well. Set aside. 4. When ready to cook, heat a large skillet to medium-high heat. Add in 2 tbsp cooking oil. Once oil is hot, shimmers and easily moves around the skillet, add steak to the skillet in batches. Be sure not to overcrowd the skillet. Sear steak for about 1 minute to brown and then flip over to continue cooking for an additional 1 minute to brown. Remove from the skillet and repeat until all of the steak is cooked. 5. Once done cooking the steak, reduce heat to medium, add in more oil if necessary, then toss in chopped onion and chopped bell peppers. Sprinkle with a pinch of salt and saute for a couple of minutes until onions and peppers are slightly softened. 6. Next, pour the sauce into the skillet, stir and simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens. Then, toss the steak into the skillet and mix well until all ingredients are combined and the steak is reheated. Serve and enjoy.

Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal

No-Bake Caramel Apple Cheesecake Crust: • 2 packages graham crackers, finely crushed • ¾ cup melted butter Mix together, press firmly into a 9-inch springform pan, and refrigerate. Cheesecake: • 16 oz cream cheese, softened • ¾ cup powdered sugar • 1 tsp vanilla • 2 cups heavy whipping cream Whip cream and vanilla to stiff peaks. Separately, beat cream cheese and powdered sugar until smooth, then gently fold in whipped cream. Apple Filling: • 2 large apples, peeled and diced • ¼ cup brown sugar • 1 tsp cinnamon • 2 tbsp butter • 1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 1 tbsp water Cook apples, brown sugar, cinnamon, and butter over medium heat for about 5 minutes. Stir in cornstarch mixture and cook until thickened and apples are tender. Cool completely. Caramel Sauce: • 1 cup sugar • ¼ cup water • 3 tbsp butter • ½ cup heavy cream • ½ tsp vanilla • Pinch of salt, optional Heat sugar and water over medium heat, gently swirling without stirring, until amber. Carefully stir in butter, then slowly add cream—it will bubble! Remove from heat, add vanilla and salt, and cool completely. Store-bought caramel works too! Assemble: Spread ¾ of the cheesecake filling over the crust, making a shallow well in the center. Add half the caramel and the cooled apples, leaving a border around the edges. Cover with remaining filling and smooth the top. Refrigerate 4–6 hours or overnight. Remove from the pan, drizzle with remaining caramel, and enjoy! #fyp #fypシ #viral #recipe #apple

Chocolate Brownie Lava Cake 🍫🌋 Ingredients: - For Chocolate Sponge - • 240g plain flour • 30g cocoa powder • 400g granulated sugar • 2tsp bicarbonate of soda • 1tsp baking powder • 240ml milk • 110g vegetable oil • 2 large eggs • 1tsp vanilla extract • 50g milk chocolate • 150ml hot water - For Chocolate Icing - • 250g unsalted butter • 500g icing sugar • 50g cocoa powder • 1tsp vanilla extract • 3tbsp milk - For Brownie Lava - • 100g light brown sugar • 50g granulated sugar • 70g unsalted butter • 40g cocoa powder • 40g plain flour (heat treated) • 80g double cream • 1tsp vanilla extract • a pinch of salt • 70g milk chocolate - For Brownie Bites - • 100g light brown sugar • 50g granulated sugar • 90g unsalted butter • 60g cocoa powder • 120g plain flour (heat treated) • 2-3tbsp double cream • 1tsp vanilla extract • a pinch of salt • 100g chocolate chips Instructions: - For Chocolate Sponge - 1) In a large bowl, combine your flour, cocoa powder, granulated sugar, bicarbonate of soda, and baking powder 2) In another bowl, whisk together your milk, vegetable oil, eggs, vanilla extract, and 50g melted milk chocolate 3) Fold in your dry ingredients from before and add in 150ml hot water or coffee 4) Line three 8” cake tins and pour in the batter evenly. Bake in the oven at 160°C fan for around 25 minutes - For Icing - 1) Whisk your butter until light and creamy 2) Add in your icing sugar and cocoa powder 3) Once incorporated, whisk in your vanilla and milk until fluffy  - For Brownie Lava - 1) Melt the butter with both sugars over a medium heat 2) Whisk in the cocoa powder and flour 3) Gradually add in the cream until molten and thick, then stir in the vanilla extract and salt 4) Let it cool to just above room temperature and then add in the milk chocolate to slowly melt in 5) Once the lava has reached room temperature, you can use it on your cake! - For Bronwie Bites - 1) Cream together the butter and both sugars until fluffy 2) Mix in the cocoa powder, flour, and salt until sandy 3) Add in the vanilla extract and double cream 4) Once it has become a dough, fold in your chocolate chips, then press it firmly into a lined 9x9” square tin, refrigerate for 30 minutes, then cut into small bite sized pieces  Watch the video to see how I build and decorate the cake! I find it’s easier to ice the sponges when they are frozen/cold. Enjoy! :) #chocolate #cake #brownie #baking #recipes

Cream chicken over biscuits with loaded bacon green beans! Such an easy comfort food dinner, and the homemade gravy is so good. I served mine over mashed potatoes with Cheddar Bay Biscuits on the side, but you can serve it right over the biscuits, too! Cream Chicken Over Biscuits Recipe Ingredients: 1 rotisserie chicken, shredded 2 tbsp butter 2 tbsp all purpose flour 2 cups water or chicken broth 1 tsp chicken bouillon Cheddar Bay Biscuits, prepared according to package instructions Mashed potatoes, for serving Seasonings: Dried parsley Garlic powder Onion powder Poultry seasoning Paprika Directions: Melt the butter in a pot over medium heat. Add the flour and stir well, letting it cook for about 2 minutes. Pour in the water or chicken broth and stir until smooth. Season to taste with parsley, garlic powder, onion powder, poultry seasoning, and paprika. Stir in the chicken bouillon and give everything a good stir. I skipped adding salt because the bouillon was salty enough! Let the gravy simmer for a few minutes, stirring occasionally, until it starts to thicken. Add the shredded rotisserie chicken and stir until everything is combined. Cover and let simmer for several minutes until the chicken is heated through and the gravy thickens to your liking. Prepare the Cheddar Bay Biscuits according to the package instructions. Serve the chicken gravy over mashed potatoes with biscuits on the side, or spoon it right over the biscuits! Loaded Bacon Green Beans Recipe Ingredients: 2 cans green beans, drained 2 slices thick cut bacon, chopped 1 tbsp butter 2 tbsp brown sugar 2 tbsp low sodium soy sauce Garlic powder Black pepper Directions: Cook the chopped bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crispy. Leave the bacon and bacon grease in the pan, then add the butter, drained green beans, brown sugar, soy sauce, garlic powder, and black pepper. Stir everything together, cover, and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, while you prepare the rest of dinner. Let the flavors come together until the green beans are tender! Save this one for your next weeknight dinner! #EasyDinnerIdeas #DinnerRecipes #WeeknightDinner #DinnerIdeas #EasyRecipe

VIRAL CARROT WRAPS 🥕 I’ve made a vacation of these with zucchini, pickles, jalapeños, and I had to put a spin on them with carrots. These are probably my second favorite after the zucchini, they come out really good, super pliable/ and they are a touch sweeter which went really well with the toppings I used here. A medium carrot has about 4 net carbs, so this is a great lower carb option if you’re watching carbs. Recipe makes 3-4 wraps Here is how I made it: 1.Preheat oven to 375F.  2.Shred 3 medium carrots into a bowl. Crack in an egg, add 1 cup of shredded pepper jack cheese, toss in 1/2 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tbsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp chipotle pepper (optional), and a small pinch of salt. Mix really well. 3.Grab a cookie sheet, line with parchment paper (important!) and scoop the carrot mixture into circular shapes. You’ll get 3-4 good sized wraps here. 4.Pop it into the oven at 375F for 16-18 minutes. Then remove and let cool for a few minutes while you prep your fillings 5.I spread a base of my homemade guac here. Just mash 2 avocados with the juice of 1 lime, a large handful of freshly chopped cilantro, 1/2 small white onion, a couple pinches of salt, and about a tablespoon of toasted sesame seeds for crunch (optional).  6.I also added some leftover shredded beef (chicken or shrimp work just fine), topped with a tsp of sour cream, some sriracha, and more fresh cilantro. Again, use what you like here! 7.Plate them up and devour. Creamy Chicken & Leek Puff Pastry Hand Pies 🥧 My husband made these for dinner earlier this week and I knew right away we had to get this one up on the website ASAP…they’re SO good! The filling is delicious enough to eat on its own, but wrapped in flaky puff pastry...this is my ideal comfort food. Pot pie, but portable! Full recipe is linked in our profile or head straight to https://www.crowdedkitchen.com/chicken-and-leek-hand-pies/ 2 tablespoons butter 1 cup sliced leeks white and pale green parts (1 large leek), halved lengthwise then sliced ¼ in ½ teaspoon kosher salt 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour ½ cup chicken stock 1 cup shredded rotisserie chicken 2 tablespoons sour cream or crème fraîche ¾ teaspoon Dijon mustard 1½ teaspoon fresh tarragon finely chopped 1½ teaspoon fresh thyme finely chopped ¼ teaspoon black pepper 2 sheets puff pastry, thawed but cold 1 egg + 1 teaspoon water, beaten Fresh thyme sprigs  In a medium skillet over medium heat, melt the butter. Add the leeks and salt, cooking for 8–10 minutes, stirring often, until softened but not browned. If they start to brown, reduce the heat. Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute. Add the stock, stirring, and simmer for 2 minutes, until it thickens slightly. Turn off the heat and stir in the chicken, sour cream, Dijon, tarragon, thyme, and pepper. Taste for salt and adjust as desired. Chill until fully cold or at least room temperature, about 30 minutes. Preheat the oven to 400˚F and line two sheet pans with parchment paper. If you have enough sheet pans, we like to stack a second sheet pan underneath each one so the bottoms of the pastry don't brown too quickly. On a floured surface, roll each sheet of puff pastry to about 13×13 inches. We use a 3 ½-inch circular cookie cutter for the bottoms – cut 9-10 circles from one sheet of puff pastry (or as many as you can fit). On the other sheet of puff pastry, we use a ~4-inch cookie cutter for the tops. Again, cut out 9-10 circles, or as many as you can fit. Mound 2 tablespoons of cooled filling on each bottom circle of puff pastry, leaving a border around the edges. Brush egg wash all around the border. Top with the slightly bigger top circle, pressing firmly all the way around the edges to make sure it's well sealed and there are no air pockets. Use a fork to firmly crimp the edges together. Optional: use the 3 ½-inch cookie cutter to re-trim the circle so it looks neat! Brush the tops of each pastry with a thin, but even layer of egg wash. Using a sharp paring knife, poke several holes in the top so steam can escape. To decorate with thyme leaves, dip the sprig in some egg wash, then press it onto the top of the pastry. Bake for ~22 minutes, rotating the pan at 15 minutes, until the pastries are deep golden on both the top and bottom. Cool for 5 minutes before serving.

Heat olive oil and a knob of butter in a pan over medium-high heat. 2. While the butter melts, lightly flour the chicken cutlets and place them directly into the pan. 3. Cook for about 2 minutes per side, seasoning with salt and pepper. 4. Add the white wine and let it reduce for a minute or two. 5. Pour in the broth, then top each cutlet with prosciutto cotto, Fontina cheese, and fresh parsley. 6. Cover and simmer until the chicken is cooked through, the cheese melts, and the sauce thickens. #chicken #easyrecipe #fyp

Please like, share, comment The Oklahoma City Thunder may have won the game against the LA Clippers, but they lost something much bigger. With just 1:14 left in the 4th quarter, OKC All-Star guard Jalen Williams drove to the basket for a dunk and was hit hard by Kris Dunn and Derrick Jones Jr. in mid-air. JDub fell awkwardly, pinning his left leg underneath his body weight in a gruesome, terrifying lower-leg injury. You could hear a pin drop inside the Paycom Center as a towel was immediately thrown over his leg and medical staff rushed out with a stretcher. The reactions from his teammates were painful to watch—Chet Holmgren covered his eyes in shock, and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander was seen fighting back tears with his jersey over his face. But the LAST moment is absolutely heartbreaking. As JDub was being stretchered off the floor, the entire arena broke into a standing ovation, chanting his name and letting out a chorus of the famous Thunder barks. Through absolute agony, Jalen Williams looked up and gave the home crowd two thumbs up. 💥bang bang chicken 🍗 Ingredients  1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs season to your hearts desire  salt and pepper onion powder  garlic powder  smoked paprika  Sauce 1/2 cup Kewpie mayo @Kewpieusa  3 tbsp sweet chili sauce  Sriracha to taste  1/2 tbsp lime juice  Instructions  1. Pre heat air fryer to 380°F. Clean and trim off excess fat from chicken thighs and pat dry. Place chicken on a baking sheet or mixing bowl, add seasonings to taste. Drizzle with oil and mix to thoroughly combine ensuring all sides are evenly coated. 2. Air fry chicken thighs at 380°F for 12 to 18 minutes, flipping halfway through. Cook until the thickest part of the chicken reaches internal temp of 165°F. 3. While chicken is cooking make the bang bang sauce. Reserve some sauce for topping. Brush remaining sauce to coat top of each chicken thigh. Crank heat up to 400°F or if you have the @From Our Place air fryer like me, switch it to low broil. Cook for an additional 5 minutes until sauce thickens.  4. Serve with rice, garnish with reserved sauce, parsley or chopped green onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

High Protein Crockpot Tuscan Chicken    this recipe is so easy to make and packed with protein. save this for your next meal prep 🫶🏽  ingredients:  - 2lb boneless skinless chicken breasts  - 1 yellow onion, chopped)  - 1 bag (~3 oz) sun-dried tomatoes, chopped  - 4 cloves minced garlic  - 1/2 tsp salt - 1/4 tsp pepper - 1/2 tsp oregano  - 1 tbsp olive oil  - 4 cups chicken broth  - 1 1/2 cups dry orzo  - 1/3 cup plain greek yogurt  - 4 cups spinach  - 1/4 cup grated parmesan  directions:  1. spray crockpot with avocado oil  2. add chicken breasts, garlic, onion, sun-dried tomatoes and seasonings 3. cook on high for 3-4 hours (or low for 6-7 hours)  4. shred chicken in the crockpot  5. add dry orzo and greek yogurt and stir to combine  6. cook on high for another 20-30 minutes, until orzo is soft  7. add spinach and parmesan and stir until cheese is melted  8. serve and enjoy!  recipe credit: @brooke | 90 lbs down 🥗 🙂‍↕️ #crockpot #protein #recipesoftiktok #easyrecipe #chicken

✨ Cheesy Meat-Stuffed Breakfast Biscuits ✨ A delicious, flaky, and cheese-packed comfort food recipe featuring golden-brown biscuits stuffed with savory ground meat and melted cheese. 🍴 Ingredients: - 1 package refrigerated biscuit dough or homemade biscuit dough - 1 lb ground beef or sausage, cooked and seasoned - 1.5 cups shredded cheddar cheese - 2 tbsp melted butter - 1 tsp garlic powder - Fresh parsley, finely chopped for garnish - Salt and freshly cracked black pepper to taste 👩🏽‍🍳 Instructions: 1. Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. 2. Cook the ground meat in a skillet with salt, pepper, and garlic powder until fully browned, then drain excess fat. 3. Separate the biscuit dough, flatten each piece slightly, and place a spoonful of cooked meat and a generous amount of shredded cheese in the center. 4. Fold the dough securely around the filling to form stuffed biscuit balls or rounds, pinching the edges to seal. 5. Arrange the stuffed biscuits on the prepared baking sheet. 6. Brush the tops with melted butter and sprinkle a little extra cheese or parsley on top. 7. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 to 18 minutes until the biscuits are golden brown and cooked through. 8. Remove from the oven, let cool slightly, and serve warm. 📝 Notes: These flaky, cheese-stuffed biscuits make the ultimate grab-and-go breakfast, packed with rich flavor in every single bite. #BreakfastBiscuits #StuffedBiscuits #CheeseLovers #ComfortFood #SavoryBaking

I’ve made ten jars like this, crimson pots, thrown crimson clay that’ll eventually be coated in a crimson glaze and then finally, they’ll be reduction fired, oh, there’s also some bronze in the mix, small fragments, which when put through the kiln turn into these red haloed flecks of metal. All of that might sound quite over the top but it’s a deep red with underlying tones of black and hopefully they resemble some of the tests I’ve fired in the past… fingers crossed. They require a different approach when crafting them, especially during the turning stage. As the particles of grog the body contains are constantly torn out I have to go back over the surface, burnishing it and smoothing it as I go to get rid of the overly prominent scratches these splinters of ceramic create. I lost a few pieces from attempting to fix oval openings, they were thrown round, but as clay slowly dries it’s quite common for it to subtlety warp. I tried to gentle press the opening back into a round shape and I felt something give; upon further inspection I found a hairline crack in the rim. Grogged clays might be tough during the throwing and the firing but it’s brittle stuff during the trimming stage, especially when trimmed as thinly as this. #clay #handmade #satisfying #pottery #ceramics

Dump & Bake Chicken Broccoli & Orzo Bake 🥦🧀🍗 If you love an easy, cheesy, comforting dinner, you need to try this one!  INGREDIENTS: • 1½–2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs • 2 cups uncooked orzo pasta • 3 cups fresh broccoli florets • 2¼ cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1½ tsp salt, divided • 1 tsp black pepper, divided • 1½ tsp garlic powder, divided • 1 tsp onion powder, divided • 1 tsp paprika • 1 tsp dried oregano • 1 tsp Italian seasoning • 3 tbsp butter • 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese INSTRUCTIONS: 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. In a 9x13 baking dish, combine the uncooked orzo, broccoli, chicken broth, heavy cream, ½ tsp salt, ½ tsp black pepper, 1 tsp garlic powder, ½ tsp onion powder, and Italian seasoning. 3. Season the chicken thighs with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and italian seasoning 4. Place the chicken on top of the orzo mixture and add a little butter to each piece. 5. Cover tightly with foil and bake for 30 minutes. 6. Check the chicken and return it to the oven if it needs additional cooking time. 7. Remove the chicken and stir 1½ cups of shredded cheddar cheese into the orzo. 8. Place the chicken back on top and sprinkle with the remaining cheddar cheese. 9. Bake uncovered for another 15–20 minutes, or until the chicken reaches 165°F and the orzo is tender. Creamy, cheesy, and SO good! Save this one for your next dinner night! 🤍 #EasyDinnerIdeas #ChickenBroccoliOrzo #OnePanDinner #ComfortFoodRecipes #EasyRecipes

Honey Garlic Parmesan Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍯🧀🍟 By far one of the best combos i’ve made, all made around making meal prepping easy and effortless. The chicken is absolutely INCREDIBLE! Macros Per Serving (10 Total) 596 Calories | 54g Protein | 51g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Servings) Honey Garlic Parmesan Chicken •Marinade - 1500g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, cubed - 3 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 130g Grated Parmigiano Reggiano - 45g Honey - 8 Tsp / 40g Olive Oil •After Cooking - Extra 15g Honey - Extra 20g Grated Parmesan - Parsley for garnish Crispy Roasted Potatoes - 1800g Raw White/Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 4 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - Olive Oil Cooking Spray, 5 seconds spray Creamy Parmesan Tuscan Sauce •Blender - 700g Fat Free Cottage Cheese - 250g Skimmed Milk - 250g Light Evaporated Milk •Pan - 30g Light Butter - 200g White Onion, finely chopped - 45g Garlic, finely chopped - 200g Sundried Tomatoes, drained & chopped - Handful Fresh Basil Leaves, roughly chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 100g Grated Parmesan - 20g Parmesan Rind Chunks Cooking Instructions 1. Cube chicken thighs. Add seasonings, Parmesan, honey and olive oil. Mix well and set aside. Prepare cream sauce. 2. Cube potatoes and add to a lined sheet pan. Season, spray generously with cooking spray and mix. Spread evenly and bake at 200C / 400F for 35-40 mins until golden and crispy. 3. Meanwhile, melt butter in a large pan over medium heat. Add onion, garlic and sun-dried tomatoes. Cook 10 mins until softened, then add seasonings and fresh basil. 4. Toast 2 mins, then reduce heat to low. Add cream sauce, Parmesan and Parmesan rind. Mix gently until creamy. Do not boil. 5. Remove potatoes. Spread chicken on the same sheet pan and bake at 190C / 380F for 20 mins, then broil/grill 5-6 mins until golden and juicy. Finish with honey and Parmesan. 6. Add crispy potatoes to the cream sauce and gently fold until well coated. Serve and ENJOY! . . #garlicparmesan #healthyrecipes #mealprep #sheetpandinner #batchcooking

Grilled Teriyaki Chicken 🔥🍗 Cook Like an Asian Ep 1: Grilled Teriyaki Chicken. Welcome to my series, where I teach you easy Asian recipes so good, your friends will think you’re Asian. 🤙🏽 Sweet, savory, garlicky chicken thighs grilled over charcoal for smoky flavor and a beautiful char. This is the series where I bring the recipes, and you take the credit. 🙌🏽 Ingredients: 2 lb boneless chicken thighs ½ cup shoyu (soy sauce) ½ cup brown sugar 5 garlic cloves, crushed 1 tbsp crushed ginger 1 tbsp sesame oil 1 tbsp rice vinegar 1 tsp mirin Instructions: 1. Mix the shoyu, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, rice vinegar, and mirin until combined. 2. Reserve ¼ cup of marinade BEFORE adding the raw chicken. Refrigerate separately for brushing during the cook. 3. Place chicken in a zip-top bag and pour in the remaining marinade. Seal, massage to coat, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or overnight. 4. Fire up your charcoal grill. Once the coals are hot, keep one side cooler so you can move the chicken if it browns too quickly.  5. Remove chicken from the bag and discard the used marinade. Grill over the hot coals, flipping and brushing both sides with the reserved marinade to build that beautiful char. 6. Move to the cooler side as needed to prevent burning, and cook until the thickest part reaches 165°F. 7. Rest for 5 minutes, then slice and serve with hot rice! 🍚 Don’t let these ingredients intimidate you because I got all of them from my local Walmart! #teriyakichicken #asianfood #easyrecipe

There are so many good recipes out there, but truthfully I’ve always had a hard time finding one that actually works for the season of life I’m in. My husband works late and I have two little girls, so weeknight dinner is on me, and most nights I just don’t have the time, the energy, or the headspace for a lot of recipes. That’s pretty much why I started making my own dinners, and I hope other moms, or honestly anyone, can appreciate them, because to me they’re actually so easy. DUMB DINNERS Broccoli Cheddar Chicken Orzo INGREDIENTS 1 box (16 oz) orzo, uncooked 1 tub (32 oz) Panera broccoli cheddar soup 2 cups low-sodium chicken broth 3 cups shredded rotisserie chicken 1 tsp garlic powder ½ tsp black pepper a few shakes Frank’s RedHot 1 bag (12 oz) frozen broccoli florets 1 bag (8 oz) shredded extra-sharp cheddar a big handful Cheez-Its, crushed HOW TO MAKE IT Heat the oven to 375°F. Spray a 9×13 dish. Dump in the orzo, soup, broth, and chicken. Sprinkle on the garlic powder, pepper, and hot sauce. Dump in the frozen broccoli straight from the bag. Stir well so the orzo is under the liquid. Cover tightly with foil. Bake at 375°F for 40 minutes. Uncover and stir. It should look loose and creamy. Stir in half the cheddar. Top with the rest, then the crushed Cheez-Its. Bake uncovered 5 more minutes. Let it sit 10 minutes before serving. Taste before adding any salt. #creatorsearchinsights #easydinnerideas #easyrecipe #easymeal #dinnerideas

EASY MEALS FOR 2 EPISODE 45 LAKSA DUMPLING NOODLE SOUP  INGREDIENTS - 3 tbsp laksa paste - 2 cups chicken stock ( i had homemade chicken stop but otherwise i'd use water + chicken bouillon) - half a shallot  - 2 cloves garlic minced  - 1 can coconut milk  - 100-200g noodles ( depends on how much food you want, i like to use instant noodles or whatever i have )  - 6-12 dumplings  ( if you have starchy noodles i recommend cooking them in a separate pot before finishing them in the broth, otherwise they could change the consistency of the broth )  - 6 shrimp  - bok choy (optional)  - spinach (optional)  Season to taste with  - 1 tsp sugar - fish sauce ( or soy sauce )  - lime juice  I just momofuku noodles + sauce in the video if you don't have just use regular noodles and soy sauce :))  INSTRUCTIONS  - add oil to a pan on medium heat - add shallots and garlic and cook that until fragrant then add your laksa paste. Cook that for about 1 to 2 minutes. - add in the fat of your coconut milk and sauté that with your laksa paste you want to cook that until the oil in the paste starts to kind of separate - pouring the rest of your coconut milk, and chicken stock - turn your heat to medium high, let that come to a  simmer, then add in your soy sauce, sugar, and lime juice. Season that to taste. Remember to taste your broth because it's your food. - add in your noodles and dumplings. Those usually take longer to cook. when your noodles and dumplings are almost done, cooking then add in any vegetables and shrimp. - serve and garnish with chilli oil, cilantro, sesame seeds ( optional ramen egg ) #creatorsearchinsights #lazysoupdumplings #dumpling #laksa #foodtutorial

Honey Crispy Chicken Ingredients 	•	2 lbs chicken breasts, cubed 	•	2 eggs, beaten 	•	1 ½ cups cornstarch 	•	2 Tbsp soy sauce 	•	½ tsp black pepper 	•	¼ cup brown sugar 	•	¾ cup butter 	•	3–4 cloves garlic, minced 	•	¼ tsp red pepper flakes 	•	¼ cup soy sauce 	•	½ cup honey 	•	1 Tbsp water 	•	1 Tbsp cornstarch (for slurry) 	•	Vegetable oil, for frying 	•	Steamed white rice, for serving ⸻ Instructions 	1.	Prepare the Chicken: 	•	In a bowl, mix chicken cubes with eggs, 2 Tbsp soy sauce, and black pepper. 	•	Add cornstarch and toss until chicken is well coated. 	2.	Fry the Chicken: 	•	Heat vegetable oil in a deep skillet or wok over medium-high heat. 	•	Fry chicken in batches for 5–7 minutes, until golden brown and cooked through. 	•	Remove and drain on paper towels. 	3.	Make the Honey Sauce: 	•	In a saucepan over medium heat, melt the butter. 	•	Add garlic and red pepper flakes, sauté until fragrant. 	•	Stir in brown sugar, ¼ cup soy sauce, and honey. Bring to a gentle boil. 	•	Mix 1 Tbsp water with 1 Tbsp cornstarch in a small bowl to make a slurry. Whisk into the sauce and cook for 2–3 minutes until thickened. 	4.	Combine & Serve: 	•	Add fried chicken to the sauce and toss until coated evenly. 	•	Serve hot over a bed of steamed white rice. #chicken #fyp #fypシ #viral #recipe

VOLCÁN CHOCOLATE 👇receta escrita👇 CLICK @laura.lopez.mon para más recetas fáciles 💥GUÁRDATE💥 esta receta de pastel de chocolate | lava cake, facilísimo de hacer con 5 ingredientes, sin robots ¡nunca falla! ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍 INGREDIENTES 4 unidades 200 g chocolate (mínimo 55% de cacao) 70 g mantequilla 4 huevos M 70 g azúcar 50 g harina trigo común (sin levaduras) Para pincelar los moldes : mantequilla y cacao puro en polvo ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍ELABORACIÓN 🔹️ Pon en un recipiente el chocolate y la mantequilla y fúndelo. Deja atemperar 5 minutos 🔹️ Mientras pon en un bol los huevos y el azúcar y bate con unas varillas hasta que espumen. Añade el chocolate y mezcla con una espátula hasta que se integre por completo 🔹️ Añade la harina tamizada y mezcla con la espátula hasta que esté perfectamente integrado 🔹️ Pincela los moldes con mantequilla a punto de pomada y espolvorea con cacao en polvo 🔹️ Llena los moldes con la masa hasta 1 cm del borde. Introduce en el congelador 30 minutos 🔹️ Saca del congelador e introduce en el horno precalentado a 220°C durante 12 minutos ⚠️ la temperatura interior de tu horno puede variar respecto a la mía (cada horno es un mundo) por lo que el tiempo de cocción puede variar entre 12 y 15 minutos. Deberás probar variando los minutos hasta conseguir el punto, pero nunca será menos de 12 ni más de 15 🔹️ Saca del horno y deja reposar 2 minutos. Separa la pared con el fijo de un cuchillo y desmolda 🔹️ Sirve inmediatamente ➖➖➖➖➖➖➖ Feliz día 🤗 #lauralopezmon #lavacake #micuitchocolat #volcandechocolate #coulant

Marry Me Chicken Lasagna Soup Recipe ⬇️  Ingredients Chicken 1½ lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs ¾ tsp Italian seasoning ¾ tsp garlic powder ¾ tsp onion powder ½ tsp smoked paprika ½ tsp kosher salt ½ tsp black pepper Soup ¾ lb sweet Italian sausage 1 tbsp sun-dried tomato oil 1 medium yellow onion, diced 4 garlic cloves, minced ⅓ cup sun-dried tomatoes, chopped 2½ tbsp tomato paste 1 (14.5 oz) can petite diced tomatoes 5 cups low-sodium chicken broth, plus extra as needed ¾ cup heavy cream ¾ cup freshly grated Parmesan 1 Parmesan rind 3 oz baby spinach 8 lasagna noodles, broken ¾ tsp Better Than Bouillon Roasted Garlic Base ¾ tsp dried oregano ⅛ tsp red pepper flakes (optional) Fresh basil 1½ tsp lemon juice Salt and pepper to taste Lemon Ricotta 15 oz whole-milk ricotta ½ cup shredded mozzarella ¼ cup grated Parmesan Zest of 1 lemon 1 tsp Italian seasoning 2 tbsp chopped parsley 1 tbsp chopped basil Salt and pepper to taste Directions Season chicken with Italian seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Brown sausage in sun-dried tomato oil. Remove, then sear chicken until golden. Reserve one thigh for topping and chop the rest. Sauté onion in the drippings. Add garlic, sun-dried tomatoes, and tomato paste. Stir in oregano and roasted garlic base. Deglaze with broth, then add diced tomatoes, sausage, chopped chicken, and Parmesan rind. Simmer 15 minutes or until chicken is cooked through. Mix all lemon ricotta ingredients and refrigerate until serving. Remove Parmesan rind. Add broken lasagna noodles and simmer until tender, stirring frequently. Add broth if needed. Reduce heat to low. Stir in cream, spinach, Parmesan, fresh basil, and lemon juice. Season to taste. Cube and crisp the reserved chicken in a skillet until golden and fully cooked. Serve with a generous scoop of lemon ricotta, crispy chicken, fresh Parmesan, and basil. People are wasting their time building AI agents. A model on its own needs context to be useful: prompts and instructions, tools it can call, and data it can trust. The old way was to write code that wires those three to the model, call it agent one, and do it again for every workflow. Harnesses like Claude Code and Codex already let an AI read and write your files, so you can put your prompts, tools and data in folders and let one AI become whatever agent your question needs. If you want something to study for the next ten years, I'd pick the Unix philosophy, Douglas Engelbart's 1962 report Augmenting Human Intellect, and plain old software logic. You already know this Cowboy Mashed Potato Casserole is gonna be GOOD! 🤠 To get the recipe, click the link in @allrecipes bio or continue reading! ⬇️ Ingredients: cooking spray 6 strips bacon 2 pounds baking potatoes, peeled and chopped 1 (5 ounce) can evaporated milk or whole milk 2 tablespoons butter 1 1/2 teaspoons salt, divided 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper, divided 1 pound ground beef 1 cup chopped onion 1 green bell pepper, chopped 1 cup frozen whole kernel corn 2 cloves garlic, minced 1 1/2 teaspoons smoked paprika 1/4 cup barbecue sauce 1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard 1/2 cup shredded Cheddar or pepper Jack cheese 1/4 cup canned French fried onions 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh parsley Directions: Gather all ingredients. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F. Grease a 2-quart baking dish with cooking spray. Place dish on a baking sheet. Cook bacon in a large skillet over medium, turning occasionally, until crisp, about 10 minutes. Place bacon on a paper towel to drain. Drain all but 1 Tbsp of bacon fat in the skillet. Chop bacon when cool enough to handle. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add potatoes and return to a boil. Cook, covered, until potatoes are fork tender, 15-20 minutes. Drain potatoes. Return potatoes back to the pot along with evaporated milk, butter, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp pepper. Mash potatoes with a potato masher until smooth. Stir 1/4 c chopped bacon into mashed potatoes. Add ground beef, onion, and bell pepper to the skillet with reserved bacon fat. Cook over medium until meat is browned and cooked through, stirring occasionally, 8-10 minutes. Add corn kernels, garlic, and paprika to the skillet. Cook and stir for 1 minute. Stir in barbecue sauce, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, remaining 1 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp pepper. Spread ground beef mixture in prepared baking dish. Spread potatoes evenly over beef. Sprinkle with cheese, remaining bacon, and French fried onions. Bake until bubbly and cheese is melted, 20-25 minutes. Garnish with parsley. 👨‍🍳: Nicole McLaughlin #cowboycasserole #mashedpotatoes #easydinners #dinnerideas

BIKINI BOD LOADED BEEF & VEGGIE LASAGNA 🍝⠀ 470 calories | 46g protein | 34g carbs | 16g fat⠀ Makes 4 big a$$ servings.⠀ INGREDIENTS⠀ Creamy layer:⠀ -400g low-fat cottage cheese⠀ -1 egg⠀ -25g Parmigiano Reggiano⠀ -1 tsp garlic powder⠀ -1/4 cup chopped fresh basil⠀ -salt + pepper⠀ Meat + veggie sauce:⠀ -400g extra-lean ground beef (90% lean; after draining the excess fat I logged it as 93%)⠀ -250g mushrooms, finely chopped⠀ -250g zucchini, finely diced⠀ -100g yellow onion, finely diced⠀ -400ml passata⠀ -30g tomato paste⠀ -1 tsp Italian seasoning⠀ -1/2 tsp garlic powder⠀ -salt + pepper⠀ -1/2 tsp ghee, tallow or avocado oil⠀ To assemble:⠀ -80g dry lasagna sheets (4 sheets for me)⠀ -30g Parmigiano Reggiano⠀ METHOD⠀ 1. Blend all the creamy-layer ingredients until smooth.⠀ 2. Brown the beef in 1/2 tsp cooking fat or a quick spray. Drain the excess fat. Add the mushrooms, zucchini and onion and cook until soft and the moisture has cooked off. Add the tomato paste, then the passata and seasonings. Simmer uncovered 7-10 min until thick.⠀ 3. In a 9x9 dish, layer sauce, 2 lasagna sheets, sauce + creamy layer, 2 lasagna sheets, then the remaining creamy layer + sauce. Top with 30g Parmigiano.⠀ 4. Bake uncovered at 400°F/205°C for 40-50 min. Start checking at 35: it's done when the top is golden and the edges are bubbling. Rest 15-20 min before cutting into 4 giant slabs.⠀ STORAGE⠀ Refrigerate covered for 3-4 days. Reheat in the microwave or oven until hot. Freezes beautifully too: portion first, freeze airtight, then thaw overnight in the fridge.⠀ Yes, one serving is a quarter of the pan. 🤝🍝⠀

fall inspired meal prep that tastes good reheated!! buffalo chicken edition 🍂🔥 High-Protein Buffalo Chicken Pasta Ingredients - 1 tbsp olive oil - 1 shallot, minced - 3 cloves garlic, minced - 12 oz uncooked pasta (penne, rotini, shells, etc) - 3½–4 cups chicken bone broth - White meat of 1 rotisserie chicken, shredded (about 3 cups) - ~3/4 cup buffalo sauce (depending on how spicy you like it) — I like @Primal Kitchen Foods  - 1/4 cup half & half - 1/2 cup 2% cottage cheese, blended until smooth - 2-3 tsp ranch seasoning powder - ½ tsp onion powder - Salt and pepper, to taste For topping (optional) * 2–3 green onions, thinly sliced * crumbled blue cheese or drizzle of ranch * extra drizzle of buffalo sauce Instructions 1. Heat olive oil or butter in a large deep skillet over medium heat. Add shallot & minced garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes 2. Add 3½ cups chicken broth & uncooked pasta. While the pasta cooks, shred the rotisserie chicken & blend the cottage cheese until smooth 4. Once pasta is cooked, stir in shredded rotisserie chicken, ranch seasoning, onion powder, salt & pepper and cook for 2–3 minutes until heated through 5. Reduce heat to low and stir in buffalo sauce and cream. Once warmed, turn off the heat before stirring in blended cottage cheese until fully combined 6. Taste and add additional buffalo sauce, salt, or pepper as desired. If the sauce is too thick, add another splash of milk or broth! 7. Ingredients: * Chicken legs * Olive oil * Garlic powder * Onion powder * Paprika * Seasoning salt * Black pepper * Italian seasoning * 1 orange bell pepper, sliced * 1 green bell pepper, sliced * 1 onion, sliced * 2 cans cream of mushroom soup * ½–1 cup chicken broth * Jasmine rice * French-style green beans * Buttermilk biscuits * Honey for glazing Instructions: 1. Season the chicken legs with garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, seasoning salt, black pepper, and Italian seasoning. 2. Drizzle with olive oil and mix well so the seasoning coats the chicken. 3. Slice the peppers and onion. 4. Sauté the peppers and onions in a skillet until they begin to soften. 5. Add the cream of mushroom soup and chicken broth. Stir until smooth and creamy. 6. Place the seasoned chicken in a baking dish and pour the creamy mixture over the top. 7. Bake at 375°F for about 50–60 minutes, or until the chicken reaches 165°F internally and is fully cooked. 8. Serve with jasmine rice, French-style green beans, and a warm buttermilk biscuit finished with a little honey. Affordable, filling, and the perfect comfort dinner. CHICKEN AU POIVRE 🇫🇷🔥 I genuinely wonder if the French are so fed up with people butchering their cuisine that they’ve started rioting in Paris. Perhaps this recipe was the final straw. Anyway, I’m convinced you could add cream to literally ANYTHING and it would taste good. BUT IT TASTES EVEN BETTER WHEN YOU ADD ALL THE SPICES LISTED BELOW. 🤓 Crispy, beautifully seasoned chicken thighs smothered in a rich, creamy peppercorn sauce, served alongside perfectly seasoned potato wedges. If you’re on a diet LIKE ME, I suggest you look away because we’re not counting calories today. 🤝 INGREDIENTS For the Chicken: 8–9 chicken thighs 2 tsp paprika 1 tsp smoked paprika 2 tsp onion powder 2 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp dried thyme 1½ tsp dried rosemary 1 chicken bouillon cube, crumbled Olive oil Salt, to taste 🥛 For the Creamy Peppercorn Sauce: 400g single cream 4–5 tbsp coarsely ground black pepper 1 red onion or shallot, finely chopped 4 garlic cloves, minced 1 tbsp freshly chopped rosemary 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 1 tsp vinegar ½ tsp yellow mustard or Dijon mustard 1 cup chicken stock or water For the Potato Wedges: 6–7 🙂 small potatoes 1 tsp paprika 2 tsp onion powder 2 tsp dried parsley 3–4 tbsp olive oil Salt, to taste METHOD: 1️⃣ Marinate the Chicken  Add your chicken thighs to a bowl along with all the chicken seasonings and a drizzle of olive oil. Give everything a good mix, making sure every piece is thoroughly coated. Leave to marinate for at least 30 minutes, although the longer you leave it, the better the flavour. 🤝 2️⃣ Prepare the Peppercorn Sauce  Finely chop your onion, garlic and fresh rosemary. Make sure your black pepper is coarsely ground rather than finely powdered. We want that beautiful peppercorn flavour and texture, not a mouthful of pepper dust. 💀 Combine the cream, black pepper, onion, garlic, rosemary, Worcestershire sauce, vinegar and mustard. Give everything a good mix and set aside. 3️⃣ Prepare the Potato Wedges  Slice your potatoes into wedges, or whatever shape your heart desires. Add the paprika, onion powder, dried parsley, olive oil and salt. Mix everything thoroughly, making sure those potatoes are generously coated. Get them straight into a preheated oven or air fryer at 180°C until golden, crispy and cooked through, turning halfway. Don’t leave them sitting around after seasoning because the salt will start drawing moisture out of the potatoes. 🤓 4️⃣ Sear the Chicken  Heat a large pan over medium heat and place your marinated chicken thighs skin-side down. Let the skin slowly render its fat and develop a beautiful golden crust. Don’t rush this part! Good things take time, and crispy chicken skin is definitely one of them. Once nicely browned, flip the chicken and sear the other side for a few minutes. 5️⃣ Bring Everything Together  Pour approximately 1 cup of chicken stock or water into the pan. Now add your prepared creamy peppercorn mixture. Give everything a gentle stir, making sure all those browned bits from the bottom of the pan get incorporated into the sauce. Allow everything to simmer gently until the chicken is completely cooked through and the sauce has thickened beautifully. The chicken should reach an internal temperature of at least 75°C. Taste the sauce and adjust the seasoning if necessary. 6️⃣ Serve & Enjoy  Plate up your crispy potato wedges alongside those juicy chicken thighs. Now SMOTHER everything in that rich, creamy peppercorn sauce. Finish with a sprinkle of freshly chopped chives to make the whole thing healthy. 🙂 And there you have it. Chicken au poivre with a little extra personality. BON APPÉTIT, OR WHATEVER THE FRENCH SAY.

CHINESE BEAUTY GLOW JELLY RECIPE ~ 100% natural. Nature’s collagen alternative ~ no refined sugar  I make these at @rawlalajuice check my stories Thursdays when I restock Snow Fungus, Asian Pear, Peach Gum, Red Jujube Date, Job’s Tears, Lily Bulb, Goji berry, Chrysanthemum, Honey  Recipe:  Makes 5 cups 1 litre water 1 handful peach gum 1 small handful snow fungus (about 10g) 2 tbsp Job’s tears 3 tbsp dried lily bulb 1 handful red dates 1 handful dried longan 2 Korean or Asian pears 1 small handful chrysanthemum flowers 1 handful goji berries Agave or Manila honey, to taste Pinch of sea salt Method:  NIGHT BEFORE Soak peach gum and Job’s tears in a big bowl of cold water. Peach gum swells 10x so go bigger than you think. Fridge, overnight. ON THE DAY 	1.	Drain the peach gum. Pick out any dark bark or grit. Rinse. 	2.	Soak lily bulb in cold water, fridge, 1 ~ 2 hours. 	3.	🔺Soak snow fungus cold water 30 ~ 1 hour NEVER leave in room temperature to soak overnight (can be dangerous!)  	4.	Cut the hard yellow core off the fungus. Tear the frills small. 	5.	Peel, core and quarter the pears. 	6.	Pot: peach gum, Job’s tears, snow fungus, pear, red dates, longan. Cover with water. 	7.	Boil, then lowest simmer, lid on, 1 hour. Stir every 20 mins so the Job’s tears don’t catch. 	8.	Add lily bulb. Chrysanthemum in a tea strainer. Simmer 8 mins, then lift the flowers out. 	9.	Off the heat: salt, goji, Manuka honey. Taste. More honey if you want. 	10.	Warm or chilled. It sets thicker overnight
